item.text: The parser is treating rollout fractions as tenths of a percent, and `new_checkout` has a special case that multiplies its value again and ignores deny lists. The reported users’ buckets are 15 (`u0200`), 0 (`u0128`), and 10 (`u0027`), so parsing fractions as whole percentages gives the expected outcomes at 25% and 10%.
